title: Circuit satisfiability and CNF encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables. There exists an assignment to its inputs making $C$ evaluate to true if and only if the CNF formula encoding $C$, with its output required to be true, has a satisfying assignment.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
